scope: actual Windows ctl wrapper, owned temporary config only

settings.label: Work mode
settings.description: Plan and execute queued work in this workspace; disabling keeps existing records.
session: normal conversation input. btw_with_mcp: durable disk inbox, consumed by the mod without interrupting the main turn; not execution approval.

settings.label: Work plan approval
settings.description: Require user approval before executing a new plan.

settings.label: Work auto continue
settings.description: Continue runnable approved work automatically; explicit waits remain.

settings.label: Work completed auto-delete (24h)
settings.description: Expire completed records after 24 hours; unfinished work is preserved.

settings.label: Work parallel execution
settings.description: Allow concurrent workers; this is not a queue registration limit.

settings.label: Pause Work parallel execution
settings.description: Pause new worker launches without terminating running workers.

settings.label: Work concurrent fork limit
settings.description: Maximum workers running concurrently, not queued requests.

settings.label: Discover pending Work
settings.description: Look for outstanding work when execution slots are available.

settings.label: Force default discovery instruction
settings.description: Use the default discovery instruction instead of custom text.

settings.label: Discovery instruction (also via SSE)
settings.description: Instruction used to discover outstanding requests; not approval to execute.

settings.label: Work P1 reserved slots
settings.description: Slots reserved for urgent P1 workers.

settings.label: Work launches per minute
settings.description: Worker launch rate per minute; queued requests remain stored.

settings.label: Work rework limit
settings.description: Automatic rework attempts before review is required.

settings.label: Discovery instruction file (empty clears)
settings.description: Load discovery instructions from this file; empty clears the path.

settings.label: Concurrent side actors
settings.description: Concurrent side actors only; durable incoming requests are never capped by this value.

settings.label: Side pickup aging (seconds)
settings.description: After this wait, ordinary side mail gains pickup priority to avoid starvation; Work execution priority is unchanged.

settings.label: Side context mode
settings.description: isolated: Work only. full/recent: router-captured parent system/history; rebase at next event when parent advances. No direct-gateway fallback; Work always whole.

settings.label: Recent context percent
settings.description: Provider-counted history share; complete tool pairs. System/tools/Work stay whole. Recent/model switch records omitted parent reasoning.

settings.label: Side model (inherit / catalog ID)
settings.description: inherit follows main; exact catalog model applies to a new side actor. An existing process forcing parent model requires an explicit future launch.

settings.label: External reply MCP bindings (JSON)
settings.description: Operator-owned JSON MCP reply bindings: exact source, receiver_id, server, tool and arguments. $reply/$event_id/$kind placeholders; inbound events cannot choose tools.

settings.label: Side priority policy
settings.description: adaptive considers P1–P5, urgency and workload; explicit follows stated priority.

settings.label: Side comparison experiment
settings.description: After primary reply, run up to four read-only full/recent × main/comparison-model profiles. Billed model calls; no tools, Work writes or replies.

settings.label: Comparison model (inherit / catalog ID)
settings.description: Second model for read-only comparison; inherit compares only context modes. Requires router capture and provider token counting for recent.

settings.label: SSE injection type (session / btw_with_mcp)
settings.description: Select a value; changes apply to this setting only.

settings.label: SSE side intake
settings.description: Select a value; changes apply to this setting only.

result.applies: live; existing workers are not terminated
